fields.why: Table 1 gives COPD death rates for 7 age groups and 4 race groups, and the text names the highest.
Sex and Hispanic ethnicity have 2 levels each; industry and occupation are exposure routes, not SES.
The 'highest' claims rest on rates (with CIs) set side by side; no test or overlap rule is applied across the groups, because the only tests are the PMR CI-vs-1 judgments by industry and occupation.
